caveats: NO PRICES OBSERVED. Every priceGbp, unitPriceExVatGbp and total is null. The shared WebSearch budget was used up before this task ran, WebFetch could not resolve any supplier host, and curl was refused by the proxy (403) for every supplier and manufacturer tried (accessAttempts). None of these was worked around and no price was guessed. Re-run this task with web access, or fill the rows from trade-account quotes.
Each observation row is a ready-made slot: item, spec, unit and suppliers to check are filled in; add priceGbp, vatIncluded, supplier, url and observedAt when read, and set status to 'observed'.

Specs that come from manufacturer data (pipe sizes, breaker ratings, precharge lengths, unit weights) are reused from docs/research/data/panasonic.json and daikin.json, which were themselves read from search-engine extracts of official Panasonic/Daikin pages. Check against the PDF datasheet before design sign-off.

Refrigerant top-up is zero for both reference jobs because the runs are within the factory charge length (single: Panasonic 7.5 m / Daikin 10 m; multi: 30 m total). Longer runs add charge per metre (Panasonic CU-Z35CKE 10 g/m beyond 7.5 m; CU-3Z68CBE and Daikin 20 g/m beyond the precharge).
Brand changes the multi-split pipe list: Panasonic CU-3Z68CBE ports are all 1/4"+3/8", but Daikin 3MXM52/68A ports B and C are 1/2" gas and need reducers for small indoor units.

RCBO choice depends on the customer's consumer unit: an RCBO generally has to be the same make and range as the board, so the price per job varies by brand. RCD type (AC / A / F / B) for inverter loads should be checked against BS 7671 as amended and the unit's installation manual; the spec rows say Type A as a placeholder, not a confirmed requirement.
The 3/8"+5/8" pair asked for may not be needed: the 7.1 kW Panasonic units in this repo use 1/4"+5/8". A 1/4"+5/8" row is included.

Public web prices (Screwfix, Toolstation, Amazon) are usually VAT-inclusive; trade wholesalers (CEF, City Electrical Factors, RefNet, Wolseley) often show ex-VAT or log-in-only account prices. Record vatIncluded for every row; ex VAT = inc VAT / 1.2.
R32 is restricted to F-gas-certified buyers and is usually sold in returnable cylinders with a deposit or rental, so a public per-kg price may not exist. Expect a trade quote.
Tool rows (category 'tool', capex true) are one-off capital costs, not per-job materials, except the OFN cylinder, which is a recurring rental plus refills.

Mismatch with the app's BOM (packages/domain/src/operations.ts, bomForJob): it adds one 'pipe-kit-5m' and one 'trunking-3m' per indoor unit whatever the run length, so job (b) with 8 m and 10 m runs would be under-ordered, and trunking here is sold in 2 m lengths. The bomSku field on each row maps it to the current BOM SKUs.
Quantities marked 'Assumption' or 'Not given' are placeholders for the survey to confirm, not measured values.
